note: Small private full-hookup RV park (10 sites) near Cambridge Springs (Crawford Co), sitting just above 30-acre Mitchell Lake. 20/30/50-amp, water and sewer at every site; grass pads up to 50 ft, several pull-through. Daily/weekly/monthly, no tents, no restrooms or showers, laundromat; open May 1-Oct 31. Sites overlook the lake from above (not on the shoreline). Phone 814-398-2652. --Claude
summary: Booking site lists 10 full-hookup sites (20/30/50 A, water, sewer) to 50 ft with pull-throughs; open May 1-Oct 31 (booking site says Oct 30); no restrooms/showers, laundromat; online booking via myrvbuddy. Rates ($45/night, weekly/monthly) shown on both sites but undated (copyright 2022), so fees left as recorded. Booking site tags sites 1-2 'Lake View', consistent with stored lakeview. Note corrected: 10 sites (not 11-12), to 50 ft (not 40).
flags: Rates are undated on both operator pages (home page copyright 2022; booking site gives no year), and the two pages disagree on the weekly/monthly figures ($245/$510 vs $175/$420); the stored $45 nightly has no 2024+ date.
